# AI-Assisted Contributions

AI tools may be used to prepare contributions to this project.

## Disclose material AI assistance

Disclose material AI assistance in the issue or pull request description. For a
pull request, fill in the AI Assistance section of the pull request template and
tick exactly one option.

## Own the contribution

Contributors must:

- Review everything they submit.
- Be able to explain the change and respond to review feedback themselves.

## Workflow

For non-trivial changes, start with an issue and wait for a maintainer to add the
`ready-to-build` label or explicitly agree with the direction.

Do not use AI tools to produce:

- Bulk or speculative pull requests.
- Duplicate or low-information issues.
